import datetime
import math
import re
import polars as pl


def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    def clean_str(col: str) -> pl.Expr:
        s = pl.col(col).str.strip_chars()
        return pl.when(s.is_in(["", "N/A", "n/a", "-", "null", "NULL"])).then(None).otherwise(s)

    return raw.select(
        supplier=clean_str("@Supplier").str.to_uppercase(),
        sku=clean_str("Product Code").str.to_uppercase(),
        description=clean_str("Product Description"),
        unit=clean_str("Pack Unit").str.to_uppercase(),
        pack_size=clean_str("Pack Qty").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False),
        price=clean_str("Pricing Price ex GST").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).round(2),
        currency=clean_str("Pricing Currency").str.to_uppercase(),
        valid_from=clean_str("@Effective from").str.to_date(format="%Y-%m-%d", strict=False),
    )
